title: Distance de marche de 6 minutes
formula:
**Male patients:**

6MWD in meters = (7.57 × height in cm) – (5.02 × age) – (1.76 × weight in kg) – 309

Lower limit of normal = 6MWD - 153

**Female patients:**

6MWD in meters = (2.11 × height in cm) – (2.29 × weight in kg) – (5.78 × age) + 667

Lower limit of normal = 6MWD - 139

how_to_use.why: - Principalement utilisé pour évaluer la réponse aux interventions chez les patients atteints d’une maladie cardiaque ou pulmonaire modérée à sévère ([American Thoracic Society guidelines](https://www.thoracic.org/statements
how_to_use.pearls:
- Original cohort did not include patients <40 or >80 years old and non-Caucasian patients.
- Widely used across specialities dealing with geriatrics and/or chronic disease.
- Intended to be carried out along a flat straight walking course 30 m (100 ft) long, with brightly colored tape marking the starting line (as well as every 60 m lap). Use of a treadmill is not recommended. More detailed instructions are available in the[American Thoracic Society guidelines](https://www.thoracic.org/statements/resources/pfet/sixminute.pdf).
- Known to be less accurate in shorter patients, who have shorter strides.

next_steps.advice: Traiter l’affection sous-jacente. La 6MWD peut être mesurée de manière répétée pour évaluer la progression de la maladie et la réponse au traitement.
